name: FunnelChart
description:
Stages that narrow, each drawn to scale with the largest: sign-ups through to activation.
Rows read in order, top to bottom. Each names its stage and its value and share of the
first; the band between two bars carries the step's rate where there is room. Hiding a
stage in the legend drops it from the rates, so a reader can compare the stages either side
of it; the table keeps every stage.

Label and value columns and `align="start"` follow the reading direction.

  micro    falling columns; the last stage's share of the first as a trail
  compact  labelled rows, passive; the label stands over its bar when the box is narrow
  full     rows with shares and step rates, the interactive legend, the tooltip and arrow
           keys: up and down move by stage, and left and right follow reading order

props.name: align
props.description: `centre` (the default) draws the funnel's silhouette; `start` lines the bars up at one edge, for reading amounts exactly.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One factual line for the empty state (R2.5): "No samples in the last hour".

props.name: errorText
props.description: What failed and what to do (R2.4): "Agent offline — retry when NST-C106 reconnects".

props.name: format
props.description: Full control of the number (the unit is still appended). Receives the chart's resolved locale as its second argument.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: what is plotted, for what, over when ("CPU · NST-C106 · last hour").

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for this chart's numbers, dates and table. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: onActivate
props.description:
Click, Enter or Space on a stage: its index and key. While set, the plot shows a pointer
cursor and its accessible name says Enter selects.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Retry in the error state. The button appears only when this is set, `state` is "error" and the tier is not micro.

props.name: stageLabel
props.description: Header for the table's first column.

props.name: stages
props.description: The stages in order, widest first. A later stage larger than an earlier one is drawn as it is, with a rate past 100%.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: title
props.description: A visible label in Metric's label role. Omit inside a panel whose header already names it.

props.name: unit
props.description: "%", "GB", "ms", or a counted noun ({ one, other })… "%" sticks to the number; other units take a space.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
